categories.main_business_segments: INTCO Recycling Resources Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the resource recycling and renewable plastics industry, focusing on the full industry chain of plastic recycling, regeneration, and utilization. Its main product lines include finished frames, decorative building materials, recycled plastic particles, environmental protection equipment, and PET products. The company integrates plastic recycling equipment, recycled plastic particles, and recycled plastic products into a comprehensive business model.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as foam plastic volume reduction and densification equipment, molecular chain repair and plastic modification for recycled PS particles, multi-layer co-extrusion technology for decorative plastic products, and solid-phase viscosity enhancement for recycled PET. It also develops intelligent manufacturing systems, including automated feeding and granulation machines, and uses vacuum thermoforming for PET products. The production methods emphasize energy efficiency, environmental protection, and product quality, supported by a strong R&D system with over 3,000 intellectual property rights.
categories.primary_customers_markets: INTCO serves global customers including large overseas retailers, home decoration and furniture markets, and industrial packaging sectors. Its products are sold in over 120 countries, with a strong presence in Europe, the US, and Asia. Key customers include major retail chains and manufacturers requiring sustainable, high-quality recycled plastic products and packaging solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in China (Shandong, Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu), Malaysia, and Vietnam. It has established a global recycling network covering approximately 100 countries for raw material sourcing and serves customers worldwide, including significant markets in Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: INTCO operates a vertically integrated supply chain encompassing upstream plastic waste collection and compression, midstream recycling and granulation of plastic particles, and downstream manufacturing of finished recycled plastic products. It also supplies recycling equipment, positioning itself as a full-chain player from raw material recovery to end-product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in recycling technologies, product design, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D focuses on improving recycled plastic quality, developing new product categories such as PE, PP, and HDPE recycling, and expanding into multi-material recycling. It invests heavily in automation, digital transformation, and sustainable product development to enhance efficiency and meet global ESG standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of recycled plastic products (frames, building materials, particles, PET products), sales of recycling equipment, and related services. The company operates mainly on a product sales model with customized and standardized product offerings, supported by global marketing and distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: INTCO is a leading high-tech manufacturer in the recycled plastics industry with a unique full-industry chain business model. It holds a competitive advantage through its global recycling network, advanced technologies, and diversified product portfolio. The company is recognized as a key strategic partner by major international retailers and maintains a strong market position in the mid-to-high-end recycled plastics market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, INTCO achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.92 billion, a 19.09% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 307 million, up 57.07%. Total assets exceeded RMB 5.5 billion, with a compound annual growth rate of 14.54% in revenue over the past five years. The company maintains healthy profitability and cash flow, supported by continuous investment in R&D and overseas expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: INTCO emphasizes its integrated full-industry chain model, combining global raw material sourcing, advanced recycling technologies, and diversified product offerings with strong ESG attributes. Its products feature high purity, performance comparable to virgin materials, and environmental benefits such as carbon footprint tracking. The company differentiates itself through innovation, quality, customization, and a robust global supply and marketing network, delivering sustainable and cost-effective recycled plastic solutions.
